key_decisions.decision: Bind separate title with opening; keep plea against divine withdrawal.
Keep destructive imperative and divided tongues rather than reducing to confusion alone.
Specific male friend and rank retained, no invented identity.
Follow read two-word death clause and retain living descent and imprecation.
Render beshalom safety; with me can mean on my side or engaged against me, note choice.
Keep ancient enthronement and difficult no-changes clause, note alternatives.
Abrupt singular betrayer retained without adding name.
Keep half-days claim, bloodshed and final personal trust.
